'''Ruvehnimaal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] who worked at [[Club Vertica Casino]] during a [[Soovada]] event. After determining that one of the guests was cheating, he asked a trusted associate to identify the cheater so that the bouncer [[Grenkk]] could kick them out.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruvehnimaal appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Nightlife event quest giver.
